svg.title: Task Router in four numbers
svg.desc: Mean accuracy over ten heads on 30 sealed real requests rose from 72.0% (v4) to 91.0% (v5). On the synthetic test set it rose from 44.0% (untuned base) to 97.8% (v4). 322M parameters, ten heads answered in one forward pass. Median latency 37 ms for short requests on Apple silicon.
